tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Find Omakase icons by meaning, e.g. "delete", "settings", "payment", "dirham". Returns exact icon names and component names. Always search before using an icon name you are unsure of.

tools.name: get_icon
tools.description: Get ready-to-paste code for one icon: install command, import, JSX/Vue/Svelte usage, or raw SVG. Unknown names return the closest matches instead of a guess.

tools.name: list_icons
tools.description: List every icon name in the set.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_icons" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Find Omakase icons by meaning, e.g. "delete", "settings", "payment", "dirham". Returns exact icon names and component names. Always search before using an icon …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
